mainEntity.name: How do I move a page in a PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drag it to its new place, or click it and use the left and right arrows.

mainEntity.name: Can I fix a double-sided scan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Choose Fix double-sided scan and the fronts and backs are put back in the right order.
